what: A ship check was unreachable from the real ship path. The pre-push lockfile check ran only when shipping a branch built outside the swarm; shipping a run never handed the run's integrated files to it, so for runs the check silently never ran. Found in review before it hid a real failure.
rule: Every check a command claims must be reachable from its real entry point, and tested through that entry point.
fix: Enforcement: shipping a run now passes its integrated files through to the shared ship logic, so a stale lockfile refuses the push; the regression test goes through the CLI entry, not the inner function. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-f.test.mjs`.
